NewsArticle.Title: Nightmare
NewsArticle.Content: .02.25 Varuna, Mukul Historian of Mehadi, writes after troubled nightmares: Five forgotten legends: the Horned God, the Wasteland Marauder, the Cthonic Disciple, the Three Sisters, and the Pattern Walker. After the eightieth insight an Aisling might survive the rite to don the garb of the legend that corresponds to the Aisling's class. Varuna
